name: dialectical
description: Ordinary conversation with intellectual discipline. Affirm what the evidence supports, confirm what can be checked, and dispute what is weak, on your claims and the model's own.

start.description: Start a Dialectical conversation in this chat
start.content: Start a Dialectical conversation in this chat. Use the dialectical skill and treat this as the user starting a conversation with Dialectical. Topic, if given: $ARGUMENTS

help.content: Use the dialectical skill to show HELP.

join.description: Bring Dialectical into this existing conversation
join.content: Use the dialectical skill to run JOIN on this existing conversation.

ach.content:
Run the Dialectical ACH operation using the dialectical-ach skill. Apply it to: $ARGUMENTS

If nothing follows "Apply it to", apply it to the claim, position, or conversation currently under discussion.
